skill.name: explore-run
skill.description: Plans bounded exploratory runs for deep learning research repositories after explicit authorization. It ranks candidate variants, favors small probes first, and keeps results separate from trusted baseline claims.
skill.summary: Plan bounded exploratory deep learning runs with conservative ranking and clear comparison caveats.
skill.author: lllllllama

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown inline code around file names, parameters, and skill names. Package helper modules locally or document verified hashes before any wrapper loads shared code from parent directories.
Clarify that backticked parameter, file, and skill names are labels, not executable commands.

content.value_statement: Research teams need exploratory runs that do not contaminate trusted baselines. This skill plans bounded variant sweeps, ranks candidates, and frames results as limited evidence.
actual_capabilities: Plans exploratory runs only after explicit authorization.
Builds candidate matrices from variant axes, subset sizes, and short run steps.
Ranks candidates with cost, predicted success, and expected gain scores.
Prunes candidates with maximum variant and short-cycle run budgets.
Keeps exploratory results separate from trusted baseline claims.
Prepares output bundle expectations for changesets, top runs, comparison, and status summaries.
limitations: Does not execute trusted baseline verification by itself.
Does not make verified SOTA or production readiness claims.
Pre-execution ranking is heuristic until real run evidence is available.
Uses shared parent-level references that should be packaged locally for marketplace use.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Quick Research Variants
use_cases.description: Rank small, authorized candidate runs before spending GPU time on larger trials.

use_cases.title: Design Budgeted Experiment Sweeps
use_cases.description: Turn variant axes, subset sizes, and run limits into a conservative exploration plan.

use_cases.title: Review Bounded Evidence
use_cases.description: Summarize exploratory outcomes with comparison caveats before trusted verification begins.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Probe
prompt_templates.prompt: Use explore-run to plan a small-subset probe. Current research is [baseline]. Test [idea] with two low-cost variants.

prompt_templates.title: Rank Candidate Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Use explore-run to create and rank variants for [model]. Optimize [metric] while limiting max_variants to [number].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Budgeted Sweep
prompt_templates.prompt: Use explore-run for a bounded sweep. Variant axes are [axes], subset sizes are [sizes], and short run steps are [steps].

prompt_templates.title: Apply Custom Ranking Weights
prompt_templates.prompt: Use explore-run with custom weights for cost, success_rate, and expected_gain. Summarize fair-comparison limits before trusted verification.

output_examples.input: Plan a two-variant small-subset exploration for a new augmentation idea.
output: A ranked shortlist of bounded runs with cheaper probes first.
A note that results are exploratory and not trusted verification.
An output plan for changeset, top runs, comparison, and status summaries.

output_examples.input: Review completed short-cycle runs against the current baseline.
output: A concise top-run summary ordered by the primary metric.
A comparability note that flags unfair or incomplete comparisons.
A recommendation for which candidate needs trusted verification next.

output_examples.input: Create a budgeted sweep with strict limits on variant count and short runs.
output: A pruned exploration plan that respects the requested budget.
A ranking rationale based on cost, likely success, and expected gain.

best_practices: Get explicit authorization before planning exploratory runs.
Start with small subsets or short cycles before larger sweeps.
Keep exploratory outputs separate from trusted baseline artifacts.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for implicit experimentation without researcher approval.
Treating heuristic rankings as verified training results.
Promoting exploratory outputs into trusted baseline claims automatically.

faq.question: What does this skill help plan?
faq.answer: It helps plan bounded exploratory runs for deep learning research repositories.

faq.question: Does it require explicit user approval?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is intended only for explicitly authorized exploratory work.

faq.question: Does it prove a model is better?
faq.answer: No. It frames results as bounded evidence that still needs trusted verification.

faq.question: Can it rank candidate experiments?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks candidates using cost, predicted success, and expected gain.

faq.question: What outputs should users expect?
faq.answer: Users should expect run summaries, comparison caveats, top-run notes, and status information.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
